description: This Java class 'PersonAttributeHelper' provides utility methods for querying and checking the existence of PersonAttribute objects in a database, using Hibernate ORM. It includes methods to check for various states of person attributes such as voided, non-voided, searchable, and non-searchable, based on specific SQL queries and logic.

classes.name: PersonAttributeHelper
classes.description: Helper class for querying and verifying PersonAttribute entities in the database.

methods.name: personAttributeExists
methods.description: Checks if a person attribute with the given value exists.

methods.name: voidedPersonAttributeExists
methods.description: Checks if a voided person attribute with the given value exists.

methods.name: nonVoidedPersonAttributeExists
methods.description: Checks if a non-voided person attribute with the given value exists.

methods.name: nonSearchablePersonAttributeExists
methods.description: Checks if a non-searchable person attribute with the given value exists.

methods.name: searchablePersonAttributeExists
methods.description: Checks if a searchable person attribute with the given value exists.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeList
methods.description: Executes a SQL query to retrieve a list of PersonAttribute entities.

methods.name: getPersonAttribute
methods.description: Finds a PersonAttribute in a list by value.
